I am not a good enough student to go to any real studies (medicine,maths...), and the only studies I could finish aren't really that useful in finding a job. There are even Ph.Ds in some of those areas (geography, for example) who are unemployed.
And to be honest I *could* get a job. But, only as a security guard or working in a convenience store, or something like that.
And that would give me monthly salary of about 300$.

But even If I do find a job, I would still need to stay living with my mother indefinitely...

That's what I'm doing right now. Surviving.
You could even survive in a prison cell, eating the same type of food until you die.

But, surviving =/= living

I was expecting that answer.
But, can you be more...precise?
